Dear Students,

We're thrilled to introduce an immersive training and internship program 
designed to propel your skills in Python full stack web development and 
artificial intelligence. This program not only offers hands-on learning 
experiences but also includes a unique freelancing opportunity where you 
can apply your newfound expertise.

Program Highlights:

	*

Python Full Stack & AI Digital Marketing Training: Dive into 
comprehensive modules covering Python development and cutting-edge AI 
technologies.
	*

Hands-on Projects: Apply your learning through real-world projects, 
gaining practical experience.
	*

Expert Guidance: Learn from industry professionals and mentors dedicated 
to your success.
	*

Freelancing Opportunity: Put your skills to work on live projects, 
gaining valuable experience and earning a stipend of ₹15,000-20,000.
	*

Certification: Upon successful completion, receive a certification 
recognizing your accomplishments.

Duration: 3 Months, From March 5th to June 5th
